sentences.text:
Present: Mr. S. K. Garg (Narwana), Senior
Advocate with Mr. Nitin Sachdeva, Advocate for the petitioner.

This petition is filed for grant of anticipatory bail in Fir No. 401 dated 19.5.2023,
under Sections 120-B/406/420/467/468/471 Ipc (Sections 409, 466 and 477-A Ipc
added later on), registered at Police Station City Yamuna Nagar.

2. This Court vide order dated 26.7.2023, granted the interim bail subject to joining
investigation.
3.  Learned State Counsel, on instructions from ASI-Prithvi Singh submits that the petitioner has joined the investigation and is co-operating.
4. As the petitioner has joined investigation and is lending co- operation, the interim bail granted is made absolute subject to compliance of conditions under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C..
However, the petitioner shall keep on joining the investigation as and when called for.
